package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// TeacherDecision atomically stores the decision audit and its outbox event.
type TeacherDecision interface {
	Record(ctx context.Context, decision domain.TeacherDecision, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error
}

// TeacherDecisionReader returns teacher-owned facts recorded for one action cycle.
type TeacherDecisionReader interface {
	ListByLearningAction(ctx context.Context, studentID, learningActionID string) ([]domain.TeacherDecision, error)
}
